changelog: New voice command "insert [word] at the start" — say it alone while dictating (or "শুরুতে লিখো" in Bengali) and the word is inserted at the very beginning of your message, so a word left out at the start no longer needs three commands to fix. The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 44 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
